pins.name: INT
pins.notes: Interrupt to your board; its level during reset also picks the I2C address

pins.name: RST
pins.notes: Reset of the touch controller; set INT before releasing it to choose the address

gotchas.text: The address is 0x5D or 0x14, chosen by the level of INT while RST is released: INT LOW gives 0x5D, INT HIGH gives 0x14. A board that does not handle INT during reset may answer at either one, so scan for both.

source.title: Goodix GT911 datasheet / programming guide
source.section: I2C slave address selection at reset

gotchas.text: Its registers have 16-bit addresses (two bytes, high byte first). The product ID is at 0x8140 to 0x8143 and reads the ASCII text “911”. A reader that sends only one address byte gets nothing useful.

sources.title: Goodix GT911 datasheet / programming guide
sources.section: I2C addresses 0x5D and 0x14; product ID 0x8140 to 0x8143
